name: Offline phone app
summary: A web app that installs to a phone's home screen and keeps working with no internet (a 'PWA'). Serve it once from a laptop or a Raspberry Pi hotspot; after that the phone has it for good. Also opens straight from the file on a computer.
use: Put your app's logic in js/app.js. When you add files, list them in FILES at the top of sw.js so they work offline.
